question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Trivial
solution:
The correct answer is "Significant."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The word "Trivial"** means of little importance; not worth considering. (महत्वहीन, मामूली; नगण्य, तुच्‍छ)

 
 
• Example: *I don't know why he gets so upset about something so **trivial**__.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of "Trivial" is "Significant."
 
• The word "Significant" means important or large enough to be noticed. (महत्वपूर्ण, काफ़ी बड़ा (इतना कि दिख जाए))
 __
 
• Example: *Police said that the time of the murder was extremely **significant**__.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__** **** ** 

 
• Huge: **very big. (बहुत बड़ा, विशाल)
 
• **Heavy: **weighing a lot; difficult to lift or move. (भारी; जिसे उठाना या हिलाना मुश्किल हो)
 
• **Light: **not of great weight. (हल्का (अधिक भारी नहीं))
